description: Annualized return of a monthly-rebalanced equal-weight portfolio of the ~497 Sept-2026 S&P 500 members (close10.pkl) vs the investable S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP) over the same months. The gap approximates the survivorship/look-ahead bias of back-testing on today's constituents (RSP also bears ~0.20% fee and quarterly rather than monthly rebalancing).
